listing.title: Homeschool Planner, Homeschool Transcript Maker, Attendance and Grade Tracker, Offline HTML Web App

guide.title: Open it
lines: Double-click Homeschool_Hub.html. It opens in your web browser.
Bookmark the tab so you can find it again.

guide.title: Add your students
lines: Everything else attaches to a student, so start here.

guide.title: Fill it in as you teach
lines: Lesson Plans, Attendance and Grades. A few minutes a week is enough.
Attendance → Quick Log Week fills a whole week at once.

guide.title: Set your requirement
lines: Compliance → Change requirement. Enter your own state's days or hours.
The planner tracks what you enter; it does not give legal advice.

guide.title: Back up today
lines: Settings → Automatic Backup → Choose Backup File (Chrome or Edge).
Other browsers: Settings → Download Backup. Keep the file safe.

guide.title: On your phone or tablet
lines: Open jps-apps.pages.dev/homeschool-hub, enter the access code from START_HERE once.
Then Share → Add to Home Screen. Turn on sync to share records with your computer.

guide.title: Print the transcript
lines: Courses & Credits holds the courses. Print → Transcript builds the document.
Save as PDF, or print on paper.

guide.title: Optional: sync your devices
lines: Settings → Sync Across Devices → Turn On Sync, then enter the sync code on your other device.
Encrypted with your private code. Attached files stay on each device.

guide.title: Getting a new version
lines: Open the new file, then Settings → Restore Backup.
Your records are not inside the app file, so a new version never loses them.
